limitations: Synthetic authenticated sessions; no OIDC/browser proof.
Concurrent team fixtures use direct synthetic SQL; they do not prove concurrent audited mutation endpoint ordering.
Team cache semantics are characterized, not strengthened to immediate revocation within the same request.

measurementScope.operationMs: Observed main BEGIN TRANSACTION READ WRITE to composition settlement; real executor enforces the full operation deadline
measurementScope.admissionMs: Actual pool-manager acquire observer; exactly one admission per operation required
measurementScope.queryCount: Physical tenant LOGIN SQL only, including outer protocol; excludes Central SQL and admin observations
measurementScope.responseBytes: JSON repository result bytes; zero for refused operations with no successful result, not HTTP error bytes
measurementScope.responseDigest: SHA-256 of result with cursors reduced to context/position; no token/expiry persisted
measurementScope.memory: Observed gate-process RSS/heap peaks include fixtures and instrumentation; no product budget inferred
measurementScope.postgresTempBytes: Observed pg_stat_database counter delta; database-wide and subject to PostgreSQL statistics publication lag
measurementScope.cleanup: Two quiet observations of pool state and tenant LOGIN pg_stat_activity, within 10000 ms; pending temporal spans stop load and defer fixture archive to outer environment cleanup; separate gate verifies portal/session cleanup
